# pbs_remotes (Data Source)

Lists the remotes of a Proxmox Backup Server, without their passwords: those on which the provider's user or token has `Remote.Audit`, `/remote/<name>` or above; PBS leaves the others out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_remotes" "all" {}

# Which server each remote points at.
output "remote_hosts" {
  value = { for r in data.pbs_remotes.all.remotes : r.name => r.host }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `remotes` (Attributes List) The remotes, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--remotes))

<a id="nestedatt--remotes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `remotes`

Read-Only:

- `auth_id` (String) User or API token PBS signs in to the remote as.
- `comment` (String) Comment; null when there is none.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the remote's certificate that PBS accepts, as colon-separated lower-case hex pairs like `pbs_fingerprint`'s, whatever spelling PBS stores; null when PBS accepts only certificates its system's CAs validate.
- `host` (String) DNS name or IP address of the remote.
- `name` (String) Remote name, such as `offsite`.
- `port` (Number) Port of the remote's API; null for the default, 8007.
- `use_node_proxy` (Boolean) Whether PBS connects to the remote through the HTTP proxy of its node configuration.
